summary: Added an environment-only empty-install hosted configuration inspector and JSON CLI with safe static messages, stable checks, operator-review flags and explicit external verification requirements. Runtime behavior is unchanged.

behavior_verified: Missing and invalid config fails with stable ids; valid HTTPS OIDC public-client/PostgreSQL/S3 role-chain profile passes without static AWS credentials or an OIDC client secret.
Runtime auth, startup and request-control loaders are reused with caught exceptions replaced by static generic messages.
Clean public origin, non-default secret, seed-off, bootstrap owner, issuer overrides, PostgreSQL and S3 syntax/prefix/path-style checks are enforced only by this offline profile.
Custom hosted S3 endpoint requires HTTPS; the default SDK service endpoint is accepted.
Permissive trust-email, domain-verification/recheck and named private-issuer flags are surfaced as warning review statuses.
Malicious/credential-bearing environment values and unknown CLI arguments are not echoed; serialized output uses only static messages and ids.
Tests guard storage/context/AWS imports and filesystem access; valid inspector path invokes no fetch.
Real CLI subprocesses produce one JSON object with empty stderr; readiness exit codes 0/1, --help 0, invalid usage 2.
External TLS/DNS, database transport/access, IAM/private bucket, versioned recovery, retention, capacity, IdP login and operational ownership checks remain required even on configuration success.

limitations: Configuration syntax and selected runtime-loader checks only; no provider credentials, live service access, DNS, database/blob operations or credential resolution were performed.
The profile is for an empty installation. Existing organization SSO, memberships and database contents cannot be inferred.
S3 syntax checks mirror existing constructor validation because there is no separate runtime S3 config loader; future constructor changes must keep this inspector aligned.
Passing configReady does not establish production readiness. Warning review statuses and all external checks still require operator evidence.
Focused tests and server typecheck only; broad suites, Docker, browser tests and hosted recovery/capacity drills were not run by this worker.
Lead owns package command wiring, documentation and rehearsal integration. Changes remain uncommitted.
